definitions.explanation: The identification of a disease or condition through examination.
Figuratively, analyzing and evaluating a situation or problem.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}の{診断|しんだん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a diagnosis from the doctor.

examples.japanese: {早期|そうき}{診断|しんだん}が{重要|じゅうよう}です。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{経営|けいえい}{診断|しんだん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: We conducted a business assessment of the company.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{診断|しんだん}を{受|う}ける (to receive a diagnosis)
・{診断|しんだん}を{下|くだ}す (to make a diagnosis)
・{診断|しんだん}{書|しょ} (medical certificate, diagnostic report)
・{診断|しんだん}{結果|けっか} (diagnosis result)
・{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん} (health checkup)

FIGURATIVE USES:
・{経営|けいえい}{診断|しんだん} (business assessment)
・{自己|じこ}{診断|しんだん} (self-diagnosis/self-assessment)

RELATED WORDS:
・{診察|しんさつ} - medical examination
・{検査|けんさ} - test, examination

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
